schema.basis: Maker B2B account cost, keyed by Schachermayer article number (SKU).

note: Drop the maker's real B2B prices here, keyed by SKU (e.g. "Br.art.112592971": 42.50). EMPTY = the whole estimate uses retail reference RRP (what the homeowner sees). When populated, the maker handoff/dashboard gains a cost basis alongside the retail range; the homeowner still sees retail. SKU coverage: appliances, hardware (drawer systems, hinges), and sink + tap — every picked catalog product.
